responsibility: This file implements GCC’s RTL shrink-wrapping optimizations for prologue and epilogue placement, including the separate-component variant. It decides which insns require a stack frame or prologue-established state, moves or duplicates suitable setup insns off cold paths, computes where individual prologue/epilogue components are needed in the CFG, emits common heads and tails or edge insertions for those components via target shrink-wrap hooks, and updates dataflow and dominance information around the transformation. Its responsibility is minimizing prologue/epilogue execution by CFG-aware placement, not merely querying frame requirements.
same_name_distinction: This implementation file contains the actual RTL shrink-wrapping machinery: deciding which insns force frame setup, analyzing CFG/dataflow, moving or duplicating setup code, and placing prologue/epilogue components on blocks or edges via target hooks. In contrast, gcc/shrink-wrap.h is only the small public declaration layer and policy macro for invoking that optimization.
